name: StoreFAQ
task: Website or Shopify chat & FAQ deflection
summary: Builds SEO-friendly FAQ pages and product FAQ accordions with JSON-LD schema on Shopify, plus an AI chatbot, instant answers and live chat.
best_for: small Shopify stores that want SEO-tagged FAQ pages with JSON-LD schema and a light AI chatbot for deflection, without standing up a full support stack
skip_if: you have real traffic, because the page-view meter charges you for the FAQ pages doing their job, or you need ticketing, agent workflows and multichannel support reporting
honest_knock:
The meter is FAQ page views, and that is the thing this app exists to increase. You install it to get SEO-friendly FAQ pages that rank and get read; every read is a billable unit. The free plan stops at 100 views and Professional at 500, which a product-page FAQ on a store with any traffic burns through in days, and then it is $0.0159 a view, up to $7.99 a month in extra charges by the cap storefaq.io publishes; neither page says what happens to your FAQ pages once that cap is reached. Unlimited views arrive only on the $49.99 tier. Success on the cheap plans costs you money, which is an odd shape for a pricing page and the first thing to model before you install.

The AI allowance is the second meter and it is tight. Twenty-five conversations for the entire life of a free account, fifty a month at $7.99, a hundred at $14.99, and $0.30 each after that. Two hundred extra conversations in a month is $60, more than the top tier costs outright, so if the chatbot is the reason you are here, price the conversations rather than the subscription and jump straight to the tier that fits.

And know the boundary of the tool. This builds FAQ content, schema and a light chat layer. It is not a helpdesk: no ticketing, no agent queues, no multichannel reporting. Anything a shopper asks that an FAQ cannot answer still lands in whatever inbox you had before.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/storefaq and on storefaq.io, and in our own test session on 17 November 2026; first read 2026-08-21) Four tiers at regular prices: Free, Professional at $7.99 a month, Growth at $14.99 and Enterprise at $49.99. They are metered on FAQ page views and AI chatbot conversations rather than on the number of FAQs. Free: 100 FAQ page views, unlimited FAQs and FAQ groups, the AI chatbot and AI written FAQs, 25 AI conversations for the lifetime of the account, AI training on up to 50 products, export and import, instant answer with live chat and standard support. Professional $7.99 a month: 500 FAQ page views, 50 AI conversations a month, training on 150 products, multilingual FAQs and dedicated support, with overage at $0.0159 per extra page view and $0.30 per extra AI conversation. Growth $14.99 a month: 2,000 FAQ page views, 100 AI conversations a month, 300 products, with overage at $0.0075 a view and $0.30 a conversation. Enterprise $49.99 a month or $479.90 a year, a 20% saving: unlimited FAQ page views, 500 AI conversations a month, 2,000 products, priority support and $0.30 per extra conversation. The overage has a ceiling: storefaq.io says page view charges stop at $7.99 a month on Professional and $14.99 on Growth, and the plan cards in the app say billing for page views and for conversations is each capped at $7.99, $14.99 and $49.99 a month on the three paid plans. The Shopify approval screen for Professional set an app spending limit of $15.98 per 30 days. One figure does not agree: in our own test session the Professional card inside the app gave the page view overage as $0.0075, the Growth rate, while the listing and storefaq.io both print $0.0159 for Professional. We quote $0.0159 because both public pages carry it; ask StoreFAQ which rate your bill uses. A Black Friday deal was running on 17 November 2026: 40% off all paid plans with code BFCMSALE40, which made Professional $4.79, Growth $8.99 and Enterprise $29.99 for the first month, and Enterprise $287.94 for a year against the struck through $479.90 on storefaq.io. storefaq.io says the Black Friday prices apply to your first month and regular pricing applies after that, and gives no end date. The App Store listing printed the discounted figures as the plan prices without marking them as a sale. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Developer Storeware, 124 Broadkill Rd #599, Milton, Delaware; the app launched 3 January 2024 and carries Shopify's “Built for Shopify” badge.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested StoreFAQ on a Shopify development store on the Free plan: the install, three test FAQs, the FAQ schema switch, the preview of the app page /a/faqs, the plan cards and the Professional approval screen (not approved). The preview said that no FAQs were found until a group was made, because FAQs without a group do not show; after the group Shipping and returns was made the question and its answer showed in the preview, about 4 minutes after the install. The structured data was not seen, nothing was paid, and the app was uninstalled afterwards. Install: the install form on the App Store page was opened in our own tab at about 17:40 and the permissions of the app were approved at about 17:41; the app opened on the page Choose the perfect plan for your store. The admin was in English. The version of the app is 3.7.7 by Storeware. Plan: the Free plan ($0) was chosen at once, with no card, no phone number and no account on the vendor site. Core action, an FAQ page: at about 17:42 the first FAQ, How long does shipping take?, was made in the group Ungrouped and the message FAQ created appeared. In the setup guide Enable FAQ Schema was clicked, which gave the message FAQ Schema toggled., and the page Settings then shows Enable FAQ Schema with the label On. A second FAQ, What is your return policy?, was also made as Ungrouped. Result: the preview of the app page /a/faqs in the theme editor said Sorry, No FAQs found. The app gives the reason: if you keep the FAQ group as Ungrouped it will not show on the front end. FAQs without a group are therefore invisible. A group Shipping and returns was made (the first try hung on a spinner, the second worked) and a third FAQ, Do you ship internationally?, was put in it. At about 17:44 the preview showed the group and, opened, the answer Yes, we ship to most countries. Shipping costs show at checkout. So the first visible result took about 4 minutes and about 15 steps from the install, and only after the group was made; the app does not warn about the missing group when an FAQ is saved. The address of the FAQ page is an app proxy path, /a/faqs, on the store domain. FAQ schema: only the On switch was seen. The structured data (JSON-LD) in the output of the page was NOT read, because the preview is a cross-origin frame and the store has a password. Whether the FAQ schema is really output, and whether it is valid, was not tested. Plans: the plan cards in the app (Black Friday offer, code BFCMSALE40, 40 percent off) show Professional $7.99 struck through to $4.79 a month, Growth $14.99 to $8.99 and Enterprise $49.99 to $29.99. Free: Up to 100 FAQ Page Views and AI Conversations 25 (Lifetime). Professional: Monthly plan includes 500 page views, extra usage billed at $0.0075/view. Growth: 2,000 page views, extra usage billed at $0.0075/view. Both: $0.30 per extra conversation after limit. Enterprise: Unlimited usage of page views. Billing for page views and conversations is capped at $7.99, $14.99 and $49.99 a month individually. Differences with the dossier: the dossier gives an overage of $0.0159 a view on Professional and $0.0075 on Growth; the app shows $0.0075 a view on Professional as well, so the Professional overage in the app is lower than in the dossier. The Black Friday offer BFCMSALE40 is not in the dossier. Checkout: Subscribe now on Professional opened a dialog with Subtotal $7.99, Discount: (BFCMSALE40) -$3.2 and Total $4.79, and then the Shopify screen Approve subscription: plan professional-monthly, $7,99 struck through and $4,79 USD every 30 days, an App spending limit of a maximum of $15,98 USD per 30 days (twice the $7.99 cap), a badge 40% off 1 charge, a row Add payment method and a greyed out Approve button, with Total $4,79 due 17 Nov plus any applicable taxes. The sentence about a test charge was NOT on the screen and a payment method had to be added, so nothing was approved; no card was entered. Cancelling: no paid plan was started, so nothing could be cancelled; the way to stop is to remove the app in Settings, Apps, which was done after the test. Not tested: the two Ungrouped FAQs (they stay invisible until they get a group), the AI chatbot and Instant Answer, Write with AI (it asks for an OpenAI key), Live Chat, import and export of FAQs as CSV, multilingual FAQs on the Professional plan, what happens when the limit of 100 page views is passed, and the JSON-LD of the FAQ schema. Clean up: the theme was not saved; the app made no page in the store, because /a/faqs is an app proxy that disappears when the app is removed; the app was uninstalled afterwards. The clock times in the notes can be a few minutes off. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app saves FAQs without a group but shows nothing in the shop for them, so the first preview said that no FAQs were found; the first try to make a group hung on a spinner; the FAQ schema could not be checked in the preview; and the Professional approval screen asked for a payment method and had no test charge sentence.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested StoreFAQ on a Shopify development store on the Free plan: the install, three test FAQs, the FAQ schema switch, the preview of the app page /a/faqs, the plan cards and the Professional approval screen (not approved). The preview said that no FAQs were found until a group was made, because FAQs without a group do not show; after the group Shipping and returns was made the question and its answer showed in the preview, about 4 minutes after the install. The structured data was not seen, nothing was paid, and the app was uninstalled afterwards. Install: the install form on the App Store page was opened in our own tab at about 17:40 and the permissions of the app were approved at about 17:41; the app opened on the page Choose the perfect plan for your store. The admin was in English. The version of the app is 3.7.7 by Storeware. Plan: the Free plan ($0) was chosen at once, with no card, no phone number and no account on the vendor site. Core action, an FAQ page: at about 17:42 the first FAQ, How long does shipping take?, was made in the group Ungrouped and the message FAQ created appeared. In the setup guide Enable FAQ Schema was clicked, which gave the message FAQ Schema toggled., and the page Settings then shows Enable FAQ Schema with the label On. A second FAQ, What is your return policy?, was also made as Ungrouped. Result: the preview of the app page /a/faqs in the theme editor said Sorry, No FAQs found. The app gives the reason: if you keep the FAQ group as Ungrouped it will not show on the front end. FAQs without a group are therefore invisible. A group Shipping and returns was made (the first try hung on a spinner, the second worked) and a third FAQ, Do you ship internationally?, was put in it. At about 17:44 the preview showed the group and, opened, the answer Yes, we ship to most countries. Shipping costs show at checkout. So the first visible result took about 4 minutes and about 15 steps from the install, and only after the group was made; the app does not warn about the missing group when an FAQ is saved. The address of the FAQ page is an app proxy path, /a/faqs, on the store domain. FAQ schema: only the On switch was seen. The structured data (JSON-LD) in the output of the page was NOT read, because the preview is a cross-origin frame and the store has a password. Whether the FAQ schema is really output, and whether it is valid, was not tested. Plans: the plan cards in the app (Black Friday offer, code BFCMSALE40, 40 percent off) show Professional $7.99 struck through to $4.79 a month, Growth $14.99 to $8.99 and Enterprise $49.99 to $29.99. Free: Up to 100 FAQ Page Views and AI Conversations 25 (Lifetime). Professional: Monthly plan includes 500 page views, extra usage billed at $0.0075/view. Growth: 2,000 page views, extra usage billed at $0.0075/view. Both: $0.30 per extra conversation after limit. Enterprise: Unlimited usage of page views. Billing for page views and conversations is capped at $7.99, $14.99 and $49.99 a month individually.
